reviews.title: Data vanishes in seconds
reviews.body:
I am writing this review to warn everyone: never take a contract with Lebara. Their service is an absolute joke, and their data system is completely broken or a total scam.
In a matter of seconds, 10 GB of data completely got wiped off my account while the phone was literally just laying on the side, completely unused! This is happening every month.  Within two seconds, it was all gone. Because of these issues, my son was left stranded without Google Maps, unable to find his way back home. It is a massive safety hazard.
When you call their customer service, it is absolutely disgusting. The call centre is based in India, and you genuinely cannot understand a single word anyone is saying to you. They refuse to take any responsibility whatsoever. Instead of fixing the issue, they blame you and claim you have apps running in the background. It is impossible to use 10 GB of data in two seconds just from an app!
I raised a formal complaint, and they promised their technical team would call me back. No one calls, no one cares, and they just keep blaming the customer. Apparently, this is happening to everybody right now, yet they still insist it’s our fault.
Lebara is a disgusting company with zero care for their customers. Avoid them at all costs!

reviews.title: I have been waiting since the 3rd of…
reviews.body:
I have been waiting since the 3rd of November for Lebara to call me back to request for a replacement SIM card which I told I would get a call back within 24 48 hours i
I called and spoke to them today twice first time I was told I would get the call today 6th on priority. Called at 6:45pm now being told they can’t call back today wait another 24hrs 

Bad service from the staff who read from a script and never any to help 

Make out another department when they all share the same floor 

I would not recommend Lebara for you to keep your number on. No other network behaves this way when you want a replacement SIM card 

Awful network staff have bad attitude take all your details never call back 

If you are on Lebara I advise you to leave the network move to an established network like Vodafone, Three : EE or o2 

Lebara is a bad network
